description: Per-client reconciliation configuration. Holds the handoff SLA (D7) that, measured from the run period cutoff, drives the handoff-delay exception, and the per-worker-feed flag (A2/C4 FED-PRECONDITION) that decides whether threshold application runs for this client or is skipped as a structural no-op. The SLA number is seeded out-of-repo; only the field structure is committed.

fields.description: The client this configuration governs. One config per client.
fields.label: Client

fields.description: Maximum allowed days from the run period cutoff to the client handoff before the handoff-delay exception fires (D7). The number is seeded out-of-repo.
fields.label: Handoff SLA Days

fields.description: 1 = the client provides a per-worker performance feed, so threshold application runs. 0 = threshold application is skipped as a structural no-op (FED-PRECONDITION); the run emits zero performance candidates, which is the expected shape, not a gap.
fields.label: Has Per-Worker Feed

name: Client Reconciliation Config
